name: ledger-append
description: The one reader/writer module for the eds-data ledger: validates an event against the record schema, appends it to the right file, reads events back, and makes the data-only commit to main that eds-data allows.
inputs: An event as JSON (--event or --event-file) for append; optional ticket and event-type filters for read; the eds-data clone for commit. The ledger directory comes from --ledger-dir, EDS_LEDGER_DIR, or a sibling eds-data clone.
outputs: JSON on stdout. append: whether a line was written and to which file. read: the events, oldest first, each with its event type set. commit: whether a data-only commit was made and pushed. Ledger lines are appended to ledger/YYYY-MM.jsonl (effort, estimate, close) or ledger/calibration.jsonl in eds-data, one JSON object per line.
dependencies: The eds-data repo (docs/RECORD_SCHEMA.md defines the record format)
